_comment: Landfall 2026-10-15: the land POSITION inside a BREAKPOINT CONTINUATION (Task 3). Seven Forests, a
Mountain and one old 0/1 Plant; hand Expedite + Forest; Rampaging Baloths on top; opponent at 10.
T5: Expedite (the Mountain, on the Plant) draws Baloths -- a site-5 breakpoint whose continuation
casts Baloths off six Forests and THEN plays the Forest: a 4/4 Beast this turn. T6: Baloths 6 +
Beast 4 = exact lethal. Every other T5 line makes no Beast (the outer plan's Expedite is not a
landfall card, so the outer plan has no land-after position; a continuation that plays its land
first has Baloths enter after it), and T6 then deals 6: win T7. So the T6 win needs the position
axis generated INSIDE the continuation list and applied by the continuation's own cast section
(ApplyPlanDirect's cont_land), with the PlayLand recorded where it was played for the executor.
